description: This interface defines a contract for filtering functions used within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifying methods to get the function's name and apply filtering based on parameters.

classes.name: FilterFunction
classes.description: Interface representing a filtering function used in Ditto placeholders, providing methods to retrieve the function's name and to apply the filter logic.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Determines whether an element should be kept or dropped based on provided parameters. Returns true if the element should be kept, false otherwise.
